data.body: [P1] Do not complete the handler future before MDC restoration succeeds. `result.complete(...)` can finalize the invocation before the resource closes, so a subsequent `VirtualMachineError` or `ThreadDeath` from MDC restoration cannot replace the selected success; `completeExceptionally` becomes a no-op, and a direct executor swallows the fatal entirely. Ordinary restoration failures can also leave plugin MDC on a reusable worker. Restore or validate worker MDC before irreversible completion—carrying the plugin MDC snapshot explicitly into end dispatch if necessary—and test both direct and asynchronous executors.
